bedb707cdded0e6cfe1c2fdb1af8032f368349fe.source: 打开录音与TextGrid，编辑最多三层，自选层间吸附与关联，用浮动音标键盘输入，试听校正并保存标注与唇形偏移。
bedb707cdded0e6cfe1c2fdb1af8032f368349fe.translation: Open recordings/TextGrid and edit up to three tiers, choose snapping/links, enter symbols with a floating IPA keyboard, audition corrections, and save annotations/lip offset.

0e23134b4d9df1fb0b020ed52e5481a18ded661d.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
0e23134b4d9df1fb0b020ed52e5481a18ded661d.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

93766b65a5e52dfcb55db9e8923abe215fef7e9b.source: 本模块用于新建或校正录音的音节、词和音素标注。结合<s id="0">波形、语谱图与选区试听</s>确定边界，再保存 TextGrid。词典、词表和强度贴合可辅助编辑，结果仍需逐段核对。
93766b65a5e52dfcb55db9e8923abe215fef7e9b.translation: Create/correct syllable, word, and phoneme annotation. Use <s id="0">waveform, spectrogram, and selection audition</s> to locate boundaries, then save TextGrid. Dictionaries, wordlists, and intensity fitting help editing; check each segment manually.

984b647a77a52df31e9feb8db628d53f12c93725.source: 中央最多编辑三层：第一层为音节 / 词，第二层为音素，第三层可自定义。右侧选择或新建第三层，也可不显示。三个层名须不同，并覆盖整段录音。<s id="0">其他层与点层随文件保留</s>。
984b647a77a52df31e9feb8db628d53f12c93725.translation: Edit at most three central tiers: syllables/words, phonemes, and an optional custom tier selected/created on the right. Names must differ and cover the recording. <s id="0">Other tiers and point tiers remain in the file.</s>

a723992834a49f312431af4e08502fb69c23458f.source: 整理录音、标注与辅助文件
a723992834a49f312431af4e08502fb69c23458f.translation: Organize audio, annotation, and helper files

2384096cfd9f7f82df07af4ebbb869c0db442534.source: 把 <s id="0">WAV 与同名 TextGrid</s> 放在同一目录，如 sample.wav 和 sample.TextGrid。桌面会扫描子目录，同名 sample.lab 自动载入为词表。没有 TextGrid 时，只准备 WAV 即可。
2384096cfd9f7f82df07af4ebbb869c0db442534.translation: Place <s id="0">WAV and same-name TextGrid</s> together, such as sample.wav/sample.TextGrid. Desktop scans subfolders and auto-loads same-name sample.lab as a wordlist. Without TextGrid, prepare WAV only.

847827f140b99a6a19409b1af9a966620a4c6703.source: 词典用 .dict / .txt，每行写标签及对应音素；词表用 .lab / .txt，以空格或换行列出待标注条目。辅助文本建议使用 UTF-8。
847827f140b99a6a19409b1af9a966620a4c6703.translation: Dictionaries use .dict/.txt, each line a label and phonemes. Wordlists use .lab/.txt with space/newline-separated entries. UTF-8 is recommended.

992ebcf29bb77f732cbd115559dc066bf145705e.source: 唇形对齐需要<s id="0">同次录音</s>的 .lip.json。桌面也可读取受控数值 .pkl 及时间戳伴随文件，建议每个录制会话单独放置。
992ebcf29bb77f732cbd115559dc066bf145705e.translation: Lip alignment needs .lip.json from the <s id="0">same recording session</s>. Desktop also reads controlled numeric .pkl plus timestamp companions. Keep each session separately.

8f8595fcf639b95c3157866070c8abf813f185cb.source: 桌面支持最大 <s id="0">2 GB、8–96 kHz、8 声道 WAV</s>。长文件必要时生成第一声道 PCM16 预览，最低 8 kHz，不升采样。图窗与试听使用预览，原 WAV 和时长保留。浏览器预览的读取预算为 64 MB。
8f8595fcf639b95c3157866070c8abf813f185cb.translation: Desktop supports <s id="0">WAV up to 2 GB, 8–96 kHz, 8 channels</s>. Long files may produce a channel-one PCM16 preview, at least 8 kHz without upsampling. Plots/audition use preview; original WAV/duration remain. Browser-preview reading budget is 64 MB.

61be9ee776f53caad0eca860bc4946708b848d56.source: 文本资源最多 2 MB；TextGrid 最多 64 层、合计 100000 个区间或点；词表最多 10000 项，每项 200 字符。目录过大或预览仍超预算时，按提示缩小目录或另备分段材料。
61be9ee776f53caad0eca860bc4946708b848d56.translation: Text resources: 2 MB; TextGrid: 64 tiers and 100000 intervals/points total; wordlists: 10000 items, 200 characters each. Reduce oversized folders or prepare sections as instructed.

ca6f85cec5c53db6466fb2af1620bdc5f15c74c2.source: 打开前先核对同一录音的时间域
ca6f85cec5c53db6466fb2af1620bdc5f15c74c2.translation: Check matching time domains before opening

56990cda11a028df0d1a77efab32802c1b6c9679.source: <s id="0">先备份已有标注</s>，核对 WAV 与 TextGrid 来自同一录音。音频经过裁剪或拼接后，旧标注可能已不适用。
56990cda11a028df0d1a77efab32802c1b6c9679.translation: <s id="0">Back up existing annotation first</s> and verify WAV/TextGrid are from the same recording. Cropping/splicing can invalidate older annotation.

cfd1eb7b098b14da8d1df034f3213c8664a0d73a.source: TextGrid 须从 0 秒开始，终点与录音一致。时间不符时先在 Praat 核对文件，本页不会自动伸缩标注。
cfd1eb7b098b14da8d1df034f3213c8664a0d73a.translation: TextGrid must start at 0 seconds and end with the recording. Check mismatches in Praat first; this page does not stretch annotation automatically.

6d5e8b96860db716510588eb0d25c477f459e4be.source: 点击<s id="0">打开音频目录</s>，再从左侧选中 WAV。中央显示录音，右侧显示<s id="1">当前 TextGrid</s> 与保存目标，可先用下图熟悉位置。
6d5e8b96860db716510588eb0d25c477f459e4be.translation: <s id="0">Open audio folder</s>, then select WAV on the left. Audio appears center and <s id="1">Current TextGrid</s>/save target right. Use the figure to locate them.

77d3cc8ba1833408caf9ef9277c53264a02782d0.source: 当前三层工作区。顶部提供吸附与关联、强度贴合、搜索替换和音标键盘，关闭工具弹窗后图下不保留参数行。图中音频为合成立体声演示。
77d3cc8ba1833408caf9ef9277c53264a02782d0.translation: Three-tier workspace with top snapping/links, intensity fitting, search/replace, and keyboard. Closing dialogs removes parameter rows below plots. Audio is synthesized stereo.

9cc895fd0b8d4c9fa7b7f7682b0e2299a2b859ad.source: <s id="0">左侧语料文件</s>：录音列表和筛选框。绿色表示找到 TextGrid 候选，仍需检查实际版本。长文件名可悬停查看。
9cc895fd0b8d4c9fa7b7f7682b0e2299a2b859ad.translation: <s id="0">Left corpus files</s>: recording list/filter. Green indicates a TextGrid candidate, whose version still needs checking. Hover long filenames.

eabe36004057e1c2ba077bc61590f4fd16c266fc.source: <s id="0">中央图窗</s>：波形、语谱图、标注层共用时间轴。图下保留选中文字、词典和词表；吸附与关联、强度贴合、搜索替换以及音标键盘均从最上方按钮打开。关闭弹窗后不占图下空间。
eabe36004057e1c2ba077bc61590f4fd16c266fc.translation: <s id="0">Central plots</s>: waveform, spectrogram, and tiers share time. Below are selected text, dictionary, and wordlist. Snapping/links, fitting, search/replace, and keyboard open from top buttons, occupying no lower space after closing.

0cba84a86a6436c683b3c79514f2ddf480b469e7.source: <s id="0">右侧标注设置</s>：选择层、保存后缀、参考复用与唇形对齐。顶部标注设置 / 文件列表可收起面板，分隔线可拖动。帮助打开本章，方法与引用查看来源。
0cba84a86a6436c683b3c79514f2ddf480b469e7.translation: <s id="0">Right annotation settings</s>: tiers, suffix, reference reuse, and lip alignment. Top settings/file-list buttons collapse panels; drag dividers. Help opens this chapter; Methods shows sources.

d1295ea750530bbad50814591cc5c05b3bdf60be.source: 初次视窗为 <s id="0">3.2 s</s>，短录音显示全段。视窗只决定正在看的范围，选区决定试听范围，标注区间记录文件边界。移动视窗不会移动标注。
d1295ea750530bbad50814591cc5c05b3bdf60be.translation: Initial viewport is <s id="0">3.2 s</s>, or all of a shorter recording. Viewport is what you see; selection is what you hear; annotation intervals store boundaries. Moving the view does not move annotation.

41d6f4d4385bae627c5b1c33d2dc1db5358b84d6.source: 读取反馈、当前版本与未保存状态
41d6f4d4385bae627c5b1c33d2dc1db5358b84d6.translation: Loading, current version, and unsaved status

ee839c8cdf261ff1936dbb57172d57e22eee6d10.source: 读取时会显示提示，暂不能切换文件或保存。成功后核对中央录音名与右侧当前 TextGrid。
ee839c8cdf261ff1936dbb57172d57e22eee6d10.translation: While loading, file switching/saving are disabled. After success, check center recording name and right Current TextGrid.

4ac3ff3820ffa0cab544c879ea14071812f204e2.source: 红色提示显示错误，普通反馈位于右栏。<s id="0">保存 TextGrid 后的星号</s>与标签页未保存标记提示仍有修改。
4ac3ff3820ffa0cab544c879ea14071812f204e2.translation: Red messages show errors; ordinary feedback is right. <s id="0">The asterisk after Save TextGrid</s> and unsaved tab mark indicate changes.

529cc031b7b1ce276e042e6e163ca4ea8671b725.source: 桌面打开目录与重新扫描

585f9844288c3f9e5f46f098a42fa8880a7c16df.source: 点击<s id="0">打开音频目录</s>，选择语料目录，等待左侧出现 WAV 列表。取消选择会留在当前页。
585f9844288c3f9e5f46f098a42fa8880a7c16df.translation: <s id="0">Open audio folder</s>, select a corpus folder, and wait for WAV list. Canceling keeps the current page.

57ebc71a73d268141031e119b6ec4d9817ed087f.source: 用筛选框缩小列表，再单击录音。读取后检查文件名与当前 TextGrid；没有标注时提示创建层。
57ebc71a73d268141031e119b6ec4d9817ed087f.translation: Filter and click a recording. Check name/current TextGrid after reading; without annotation, create tiers is offered.

96ed24ff93638ed0c4c5512042d7dd7cf5abf326.source: 目录中新增文件后点击<s id="0">扫描</s>。扫描、换目录或换录音前会先尝试保存修改，失败时保留当前编辑。
96ed24ff93638ed0c4c5512042d7dd7cf5abf326.translation: <s id="0">Scan</s> after adding files. Scanning/folder/recording switches first attempt to save edits; failure retains current work.

7403db7e817c9271004531a2c766eec96e2ee80f.source: 浏览器预览与项目入口

edae3247355b6056df148b385ada2ffe97fbb9e7.source: 浏览器预览点击<s id="0">打开语料文件</s>，一次选入 WAV、TextGrid、LAB 和需要的安全唇形 JSON，再从左侧打开录音。服务器项目读取项目内资源。
edae3247355b6056df148b385ada2ffe97fbb9e7.translation: In browser preview, <s id="0">Open corpus files</s> selects WAV, TextGrid, LAB, and needed safe lip JSON together. Then choose audio on the left. Server projects read their resources.

a8fd1fc3045c969792d0e7d4fde6a77c29935ee0.source: 同名优先级与多个候选

4cb5d225caa23de7f34f3256453cb7611e7f5651.source: <s id="0">原始同名 TextGrid 优先</s>，随后依次为 _自动保存、_webedit、_post、_auto。没有这些版本时，唯一同名前缀候选可载入；多个候选需明确选择。
4cb5d225caa23de7f34f3256453cb7611e7f5651.translation: <s id="0">Original same-name TextGrid takes priority</s>, then _自动保存, _webedit, _post, _auto. Otherwise a unique same-prefix candidate may load; multiple candidates need explicit choice.

f430359c29c96f0b8e3cc7c1ac29b667a2092382.source: 当前 TextGrid 名与内容

a21939dcad3813f9a58f03341a8dc4ac9422b674.source: 继续编辑或改选恢复版

aa926894d98e9017b94ebb75ff24d1e426ba2614.source: 选择关联 TextGrid 弹窗

c9e3bd842fea060bb62c478cef8f17abf2f7f653.source: 在候选窗口明确选择版本

eae64fadb85d8e7240a6c45170754a2e2650675a.source: 在<s id="0">选择关联 TextGrid</s> 窗口选本次文件，再点击<s id="1">打开标注</s>。未选择时按钮不可用，取消返回当前页。
eae64fadb85d8e7240a6c45170754a2e2650675a.translation: Select a file in <s id="0">Choose linked TextGrid</s>, then <s id="1">Open annotation</s>. Disabled until selected; Cancel returns.

0a74e94f7ebe7ed8df98639951dfe0e1c74fa812.source: 读取后再次核对右侧文件名。恢复旧编辑时，先保护当前修改，再从<s id="0">当前 TextGrid</s>下拉明确选择 _自动保存 或其他版本。
0a74e94f7ebe7ed8df98639951dfe0e1c74fa812.translation: Recheck right-hand filename afterward. To restore old edits, protect current changes first, then choose _自动保存 or another version under <s id="0">Current TextGrid</s>.

fcb8a7df019ff8638b956045eba8c5fa64e19445.source: 多个候选时，明确选择本次使用的TextGrid，再点击打开标注。
fcb8a7df019ff8638b956045eba8c5fa64e19445.translation: With multiple candidates, choose this session's TextGrid, then Open annotation.

1ca4ac4d0cde1412df92aa7bf7b2f5df145e1c5c.source: 关联弹窗局部：先选正确标注文件，再点击打开标注。
1ca4ac4d0cde1412df92aa7bf7b2f5df145e1c5c.translation: Association close-up: choose the correct file before opening.

46efbefda3451ed9822b68d11f2cc54be2578295.source: 第一次标注的完整检查

be2b036680d647e6c9ef0f2fb63e77b0d263b01a.source: <s id="0">打开录音</s>：选目录或文件，再从左侧单击 WAV，核对 TextGrid 版本。
be2b036680d647e6c9ef0f2fb63e77b0d263b01a.translation: <s id="0">Open recording</s>: choose folder/files, click WAV left, and check TextGrid version.

78ce1e4d73d3142be26835db31f76e3220e9b9be.source: <s id="0">准备标注层</s>：已有层时指定音节 / 词与音素角色，没有层时点击创建标注层，填写不同名称。
78ce1e4d73d3142be26835db31f76e3220e9b9be.translation: <s id="0">Prepare tiers</s>: assign syllable/word and phoneme roles, or Create annotation tiers with distinct names.

7508ff044f1906a6030ef66e818c2f87f2357fde.source: <s id="0">标注并试听</s>：关闭顺序开关，双击空白起点与终点，在选中区间文本输入标签并按 Enter。拖动边界后选区试听，误操作用 Ctrl＋Z。
7508ff044f1906a6030ef66e818c2f87f2357fde.translation: <s id="0">Annotate and audition</s>: turn sequential mode off, double-click empty start/end positions, type into selected-interval text, and Enter. Audition after boundary dragging; Ctrl+Z undoes mistakes.

52bf3305bbadb1fab1155da87cf7a6dde16f9565.source: <s id="0">保存并回读</s>：核对右侧目标，点击保存 TextGrid，等成功反馈；需要确认时重新选择目标版。唇形偏移另点保存唇偏。
52bf3305bbadb1fab1155da87cf7a6dde16f9565.translation: <s id="0">Save and read back</s>: check target right, Save TextGrid, wait for success, and reselect target version if needed. Save lip offset separately.

cc04d831be054286e043c4aad829c9fb75180dfd.source: 下表用于快速查找控件。已存层名、后缀、首次切分方式和面板开合可恢复，实际值以当前界面为准。
cc04d831be054286e043c4aad829c9fb75180dfd.translation: Quick control reference follows. Saved tier names, suffixes, initial splitting, and panel states may restore; use current displayed values.

8b61b78584b6e1938d3fb176f819c898b0a1de36.source: 文件、工具栏与关联控件

e255dd3629a18823afb72dbb271cc9b8678ad94d.source: 多选 WAV 与关联文件

92ee651945f477edc09f8c8c5f4ba4ca6c3e63e4.source: 按手动后缀保存，星号表示修改

2b31d7f8577a1647c7611c70f025e5327c38c45a.source: 按文件名筛选，清空恢复

8fe9e5c68eb582f69f77a478bbb4549391f70901.source: 可切换吸附与各层关联

5ffcb77c1c6fe5fa7bd373c5e3b25b42dca3520b.source: 选择层与普通人工标注

a802cea67ea728758d929addd116ffd4552307b1.source: 把已有层指定为编辑角色
a802cea67ea728758d929addd116ffd4552307b1.translation: Assign existing tiers to editing roles

bf1b0fe04cf45e2fd9057ce708eac15a309621cf.source: 展开标注设置，在音节 / 词层、音素层和可选第三层选择不同的全域区间层。中央最多三行随角色选择更新，层本身内容保留。
bf1b0fe04cf45e2fd9057ce708eac15a309621cf.translation: In Annotation settings, choose distinct full-domain interval tiers for syllables/words, phonemes, and optional third tier. Up to three central rows follow role choices; tier contents remain.

6833f0f65b682a3f354a0ed3d96144373bd2ef01.source: 缺少层时创建全域空白层

ed19339a7122a5952c520baadd0b420045e68b2a.source: 缺少一层时点击<s id="0">新建音节 / 词层</s>或<s id="1">新建音素层</s>；都缺少时点击<s id="2">创建标注层</s>。
ed19339a7122a5952c520baadd0b420045e68b2a.translation: For one missing tier, <s id="0">New syllable/word tier</s> or <s id="1">New phoneme tier</s>. If both are missing, <s id="2">Create annotation tiers</s>.

846ee7ff181cb39b9bf972d921917444835cca9c.source: 填写未使用的名称，点<s id="0">创建层</s>。新层以空白区间覆盖全录音，已有层保留，随后保存才写入文件。
846ee7ff181cb39b9bf972d921917444835cca9c.translation: Enter an unused name and <s id="0">Create tiers</s>. New blank intervals cover the whole recording; existing tiers remain. Save afterward to write files.

d3508af0ec52d5d90c7def569741323f154ad944.source: 层名须为 1–200 字符，不含换行，不能与已有层或另一新层重复。取消不会创建层。点层或非全域区间层可保留，无法指定为编辑角色。
d3508af0ec52d5d90c7def569741323f154ad944.translation: Names: 1–200 characters, no newlines or duplicates with existing/new tiers. Cancel creates nothing. Point/non-full-domain interval tiers remain but cannot be editing roles.

a6a2dc1ffb558e26e1cdcfda6d8012ecba469945.source: 创建标注层时可同时填写音节、音素和声调三个不同名称，第三层可留空。已有层保留。
a6a2dc1ffb558e26e1cdcfda6d8012ecba469945.translation: Create distinct syllable, phoneme, and tone names together; the third may be blank. Existing tiers remain.

ec1ee7f996ac35b3c382ce1554bd8fa2492406a5.source: 创建层弹窗局部：两个主要编辑层和一个可选第三层。
ec1ee7f996ac35b3c382ce1554bd8fa2492406a5.translation: Create-tier close-up with two primary tiers and one optional third tier.

6839f0d8be25fc7c5e4ad397c43927265e5406f0.source: 词典辅助及普通人工标注

1bf093827ba43a31b99693ab2cd1228f0aa037c3.source: 每行格式为<s id="0">标签 音素1 音素2 …</s>，以空白分隔，标签匹配忽略大小写。词典可使用不同语言或音系，例如：
1bf093827ba43a31b99693ab2cd1228f0aa037c3.translation: Each line is <s id="0">label phoneme1 phoneme2 …</s>, whitespace-separated, with case-insensitive labels. Dictionaries may represent different languages/phonologies, for example:

88dcf7c80e416bbf8a8cabc469e032029bd7cc74.source: 上传后核对对应与条目数
88dcf7c80e416bbf8a8cabc469e032029bd7cc74.translation: Check mappings and count after upload

be85d434ac57ec3bc78ff5380a1805fa99b8d188.source: 点击<s id="0">上传词典</s>，选择 .dict / .txt，成功后显示文件名与条目数。
be85d434ac57ec3bc78ff5380a1805fa99b8d188.translation: <s id="0">Upload dictionary</s> selects .dict/.txt; success shows filename and entry count.

8e8b1a1344a4f710ed971c94a08a5cb941c7b2b4.source: 词层与音素层关联时，普通模式下双击已有文字的词区间，按词典均分音素，再逐段拖动边界和试听。未命中时使用拼音回退，非拼音标签按单段保留。取消关联后音素层独立编辑。
8e8b1a1344a4f710ed971c94a08a5cb941c7b2b4.translation: With linked word/phoneme tiers, double-click a labeled word in normal mode to divide phonemes evenly from the dictionary, then drag/audition boundaries. Missing entries use pinyin fallback; non-pinyin stays one segment. Unlink for independent phoneme editing.

3cdf894a904555dd4615015251f7b6e55bbe46e5.source: 上传不会自动重切所有已有标注。<s id="0">普通模式修改词文字或双击已有词，会重建该词音素边界</s>。精细标注先另存，改字后再检查音素层。
3cdf894a904555dd4615015251f7b6e55bbe46e5.translation: Uploading does not resplit all existing annotation. <s id="0">Normal-mode word edits or double-clicks rebuild that word's phoneme boundaries.</s> Save fine annotations separately and recheck phonemes after text edits.

ec2d5c7f22253dc668b2cef39256f570c3cca58e.source: 不使用词表，从空白处定界
ec2d5c7f22253dc668b2cef39256f570c3cca58e.translation: Set boundaries in blank space without a wordlist

c525ca62255605f6b686ac452f00150860d51fef.source: 没有词表也能标注。保持<s id="0">自动生成音节和音素</s>关闭，按下面步骤建立区间。
c525ca62255605f6b686ac452f00150860d51fef.translation: Without a wordlist, keep <s id="0">Generate syllables and phonemes automatically</s> off and create intervals as follows.

607e55e2e8f5fd6b1c7fd61e065091eae13b2918.source: 在波形、语谱图或空白音节层<s id="0">双击起点，再双击较晚的终点</s>，成功后选中新空白区间。
607e55e2e8f5fd6b1c7fd61e065091eae13b2918.translation: In waveform, spectrogram, or blank syllable tier, <s id="0">double-click a start, then a later end</s>. The new blank interval becomes selected.

8b0c4fbfb847e4731a0785179d642160662d35ee.source: 在<s id="0">选中区间文本</s>输入标签，按 Enter 或移开焦点提交。已有区间可单击后同样改字，音素标签可单独修改。
8b0c4fbfb847e4731a0785179d642160662d35ee.translation: Type into <s id="0">Selected interval text</s> and commit with Enter or blur. Click existing intervals to edit similarly; phoneme labels edit separately.

a8f4c5ee7d6eab8c02488722c78d0b305d1faa2d.source: 需要额外音素边界时，在音素区间内双击，再逐段核对标签。起点选错用 <s id="0">Esc / 取消起点（Esc）</s>重选；终点早于起点或覆盖非空标注会拒绝。
a8f4c5ee7d6eab8c02488722c78d0b305d1faa2d.translation: For more phoneme boundaries, double-click inside a phoneme interval and check labels. Reset a wrong start with <s id="0">Esc / Cancel start (Esc)</s>. Earlier ends or overlap with nonempty annotations are rejected.

ae920a1907922306c96b1cbdde15902da37c904f.source: 录音内容与次序已知时，可以用词表减少录入。如 <s id="0">zhe4 shi4 shang4</s>。拼音带调号，顺序模式按声母和完整韵母分组，shang4 为 sh / ang4，韵尾保留在韵母内。
ae920a1907922306c96b1cbdde15902da37c904f.translation: Known text/order can reduce typing, e.g. <s id="0">zhe4 shi4 shang4</s>. Use numbered tones. Sequential mode groups initials and whole finals: shang4 is sh / ang4, keeping the coda in the final.

8b35db158049bfe45c5bb7501e413b734e05687e.source: 先准备顺序、层与切分方式

709d19e7fda460ed236b709e4ad496f99d1ea653.source: 先选好音节 / 词层和音素层，再<s id="0">上传词表</s>，或点击<s id="1">粘贴词表</s>，按录音顺序输入条目并点<s id="2">应用词表</s>。
709d19e7fda460ed236b709e4ad496f99d1ea653.translation: Choose syllable/word and phoneme tiers, then <s id="0">Upload wordlist</s> or <s id="1">Paste wordlist</s>, enter recording order, and <s id="2">Apply wordlist</s>.

97f0611fef2e33597c3928cfbb5dafce00040f61.source: 勾选<s id="0">自动生成音节和音素</s>，核对<s id="1">首次音素切分</s>和<s id="2">下一音节</s>。词表中的标签会高亮，重复条目仍需按顺序检查。该开关辅助填字，边界由点击确定。
97f0611fef2e33597c3928cfbb5dafce00040f61.translation: Enable <s id="0">Generate syllables and phonemes automatically</s>; check <s id="1">Initial phoneme split</s> and <s id="2">Next syllable</s>. Labels highlight; check repeated entries in order. It assists text, while clicks determine boundaries.

dfd801973c68e79c4a84f80baf25dd4f489b3e4f.source: 词典、词表、顺序开关、首次音素切分和下一音节仍位于图窗下方；本例已粘贴四个演示条目并开启顺序标注。
dfd801973c68e79c4a84f80baf25dd4f489b3e4f.translation: Dictionary, wordlist, sequential switch, initial split, and next syllable remain below plots. Four demonstration items are pasted and sequential annotation is on.

a6a3457c0082313eeb45303ad82e8e622033be04.source: 双击起点，检查待定状态
a6a3457c0082313eeb45303ad82e8e622033be04.translation: Double-click start and check pending state

712e9b9335bd27c6731ed37ecb6822dc68a949da.source: 第一次双击后出现<s id="0">待定起点</s>与虚线，右栏显示起点时间和待生成条目。此时尚未建立音节，词表进度也未推进。
712e9b9335bd27c6731ed37ecb6822dc68a949da.translation: First double-click shows <s id="0">Pending start</s> and a dashed line, with time/item right. No syllable exists yet and progress has not advanced.

b601a98c229a54d16cd1bc9b3e8705f287addc0d.source: 双击后显示待定起点，等待终点建立当前条目。图中使用合成演示音频，真实标注需结合录音定位。
b601a98c229a54d16cd1bc9b3e8705f287addc0d.translation: Pending start waits for the end to form an item. Audio is synthesized; real boundaries need actual audio inspection.

8c9f86c18defb366595b0a4ecd4e483f442320c5.source: 第二次双击终点，完成一个音节
8c9f86c18defb366595b0a4ecd4e483f442320c5.translation: Double-click end to finish one syllable

2929a4f1fd8554d41a8955df3f1747c9d2cb9b1f.source: 再到更晚的位置<s id="0">双击终点</s>。可跨波形、语谱图或第一层操作。成功后第一层填入条目，词与音素关联时第二层建立同起止段；下一音节向后推进。
2929a4f1fd8554d41a8955df3f1747c9d2cb9b1f.translation: <s id="0">Double-click a later end</s> in waveform, spectrogram, or first tier. Success fills tier one; linked phonemes get matching bounds and Next syllable advances.

1186f5ccf691aabc9a3873da86ed34e9dcf17240.source: 在音节内部切分首个音素边界
1186f5ccf691aabc9a3873da86ed34e9dcf17240.translation: Split the first internal phoneme boundary

f813dc58be5628fdb728b20d886fb89827a53e30.source: 在已建立音节内部<s id="0">双击声母 / 韵母分界</s>。默认第一边界用双击位置，也可选按音素数等分。后续多个音素在剩余时间内均分。
f813dc58be5628fdb728b20d886fb89827a53e30.translation: Inside a created syllable, <s id="0">double-click the initial/final boundary</s>. Default uses that position; equal division by phoneme count is optional. Later phonemes divide the remaining duration evenly.

aebb0557c7cd146a5acb7f7ee26b34ac5c157b0e.source: 零声母拼音保留一段。首次切分后，需要更多边界时在音素层双击，已有边界保留。
aebb0557c7cd146a5acb7f7ee26b34ac5c157b0e.translation: Zero-initial pinyin remains one segment. Add further boundaries by double-clicking the phoneme tier; existing boundaries remain.

51c0cb9536cf8accb6ea99569ccf6d699edfcd58.source: 建立zhe4后在音素层内部双击，形成zh/e4两个区间。图中为合成演示，实际切分需试听检查。
51c0cb9536cf8accb6ea99569ccf6d699edfcd58.translation: After zhe4 is created, double-click the phoneme tier to form zh/e4. The example is synthesized; audition real boundaries.

2fa17ac3b532dd18614cc3f8963c546a92a88dba.source: 连续段、有停顿段与进度恢复
2fa17ac3b532dd18614cc3f8963c546a92a88dba.translation: Adjacent segments, pauses, and progress recovery

eaae3c4ff5c4b4e3a8beec339fbc887ea94cb51b.source: <s id="0">有停顿</s>：普通双击下一起点与终点，保留中间空白。<s id="1">紧接前段</s>：Ctrl＋双击下一终点，沿用前段终点。
eaae3c4ff5c4b4e3a8beec339fbc887ea94cb51b.translation: <s id="0">With a pause</s>: double-click next start/end normally to retain blank space. <s id="1">Immediately adjacent</s>: Ctrl+double-click next end to reuse the previous end.

b40c9f7f8bd9e459b7fa6234a2be188e864a8638.source: 起点错误用 <s id="0">Esc</s>取消。词表进度错误就在<s id="1">下一音节</s>改选，原标注保留。新段重叠或越界会拒绝，失败不消耗条目。
b40c9f7f8bd9e459b7fa6234a2be188e864a8638.translation: Cancel wrong starts with <s id="0">Esc</s>. Correct wordlist progress using <s id="1">Next syllable</s>; old annotation remains. Overlap/out-of-bounds fails without consuming an item.

b0b8d5ac93ce5f07323025eb5c189e2280c8ccf9.source: 完成后取消勾选，逐段复核并保存。撤销会恢复标注和对应词表进度，内部音素切分不消耗下一条。
b0b8d5ac93ce5f07323025eb5c189e2280c8ccf9.translation: Turn off after completion, review each segment, and save. Undo restores annotation and corresponding list progress; internal phoneme splitting consumes no next item.

20508f0db7cfb22bf05f6ceb7de7df0d969d45d7.source: 顺序模式改词文字时沿用手工音素时间并更新标签；普通模式和搜索替换会重填音素。不同模式切换后，先检查一个音节再继续。
20508f0db7cfb22bf05f6ceb7de7df0d969d45d7.translation: Sequential-mode text edits retain manual phoneme times and update labels; normal mode/search replace refills phonemes. Check one syllable after switching modes before proceeding.

bdfbffee13f8e00964049301ddfeb5f6bc9cfc95.source: 关闭顺序开关或<s id="0">清除词表</s>只停止待标注顺序与高亮，已生成区间保留。
bdfbffee13f8e00964049301ddfeb5f6bc9cfc95.translation: Turning sequential mode off or <s id="0">Clear wordlist</s> stops order/highlighting only; generated intervals remain.

27fa97c911b3aa03e6e3e370e19f1e901b82db0d.source: 词典、词表、顺序标注与替换
27fa97c911b3aa03e6e3e370e19f1e901b82db0d.translation: Dictionary, wordlist, sequential annotation, and replacement

e91dcdfac62ec2d435db84c36e09afead91600a0.translation: At least two fields per line

d5b1683afd2d0f95a65c47be7f9e9df0455ddcf8.source: 无词表，同名 LAB 可载入
d5b1683afd2d0f95a65c47be7f9e9df0455ddcf8.translation: No list; same-name LAB can load

07e5601d4ec7fd1449c489766ff09fdbf9574c8c.source: 粘贴词表 / 应用词表

228771c05a535fb741ea8d93c42ccbdad2046acf.source: 默认关闭，需两个编辑层
228771c05a535fb741ea8d93c42ccbdad2046acf.translation: Off by default; two editing tiers needed

e1abddc7b7b45641e9933e06ad23fe5796340236.translation: Equal split by phoneme count optional

1447bff411d5eca8ad6e9334c7210fa6fb0ea1b9.source: 全部替换 / 替换全部

260f47d4d9ff0cf29fec4e34a1016c17e5c3ce97.translation: Check count; undo as one step

e416e44958119b259d68f4f445e379d4fe29b2c3.source: <s id="0">先让焦点离开输入框，再用图面快捷键</s>。输入框内保留系统文字剪贴、退格和撤销。中文或 IPA 建议在<s id="1">选中区间文本</s>输入；Ctrl / Meta＋S 可提交字段并保存。
e416e44958119b259d68f4f445e379d4fe29b2c3.translation: <s id="0">Move focus outside text inputs before plot shortcuts</s>. Inputs retain system text clipboard, backspace, and undo. Use <s id="1">Selected interval text</s> for Chinese/IPA; Ctrl/Meta+S commits fields and saves.

cb2574a7027ea5a0a61682b2f3c7da4df5969a5b.source: 选择试听范围与暂停继续

a29169b762717393d4f1a5bea332f331a60c73ef.source: 在波形或语谱图<s id="0">左键拖选</s>，支持反向选择；单击标注区间也会同步试听范围。
a29169b762717393d4f1a5bea332f331a60c73ef.translation: <s id="0">Left-drag</s> waveform/spectrogram in either direction. Clicking an interval also sets audition range.

618579d137da9809424d18e01de942f7a21c7c66.source: 按 <s id="0">空格 / P</s>播放或暂停，到选区终点停止。相同选区可继续播放，改选从新起点开始。未选有效范围时会提示先选择。
618579d137da9809424d18e01de942f7a21c7c66.translation: <s id="0">Space / P</s> plays/pauses until range end. Same selection resumes; changing starts anew. Invalid range prompts selection.

683bac0032e6afe2b23315a66fcf286089445aef.source: 在波形或标注层边界左键拖动，调整两侧区间。已关联层准确重合的边界会联动，取消关联后只调整当前层。层间边界吸附开关决定是否对齐邻近边界。移动不能跨过相邻内部边界。
683bac0032e6afe2b23315a66fcf286089445aef.translation: Left-drag waveform/tier boundaries to adjust adjacent intervals. Exactly coincident linked-tier boundaries move together; unlinked tiers act alone. Snapping controls nearby alignment. Movement cannot cross neighboring internal boundaries.

d8ca58577b949c5b5889f45197f6ebc88ad3d774.source: Ctrl＋拖动共用边界可拉出空白：向左缩短左段，向右缩短右段，另一侧保留原时间。在第一层操作时，关联下层的对应重合边界跟随，独立层保留原位。完成后检查两侧标签。
d8ca58577b949c5b5889f45197f6ebc88ad3d774.translation: Ctrl+drag a shared boundary: left shortens the left interval, right shortens the right, leaving the other unchanged. On tier one, coincident linked lower boundaries follow; independent tiers stay. Check both labels afterward.

3ed3a0ded620939295c938b53ff7e9a83b6b9a52.source: 选中有文字的音节后拖动，或按左右方向键，整体移动音节及关联层中对应的标注，独立层保留原位。音素和第三层也可独立移动各自区间。微调步长在右侧设置，默认 1 ms。
3ed3a0ded620939295c938b53ff7e9a83b6b9a52.translation: Drag a labeled syllable or use left/right arrows to move it and corresponding linked annotations; independent tiers stay. Phoneme/third-tier intervals move independently too. Right settings give nudge step, default 1 ms.

9ae71c65c0209c3000049c5b105783eb36f53edb.source: <s id="0">Shift＋左键拖动</s>框选，或 <s id="1">Ctrl＋单击</s>离散多选，再整体移动。音节层空白处拖动也可框选。时长与组内间距保留，重叠、越界或跨界音素会拒绝。
9ae71c65c0209c3000049c5b105783eb36f53edb.translation: <s id="0">Shift+left-drag</s> boxes items, or <s id="1">Ctrl+click</s> selects separately for group moves. Blank syllable areas also box-select. Duration/spacing remain; overlap, bounds, or crossing phonemes are rejected.

9b2a6f25d056043c701ab3364f715db73842ce8f.source: Backspace / Delete：选中区间时删除标注并在原时段留空，词层关联的下层选区一并处理，独立层保留。选中内部边界时合并两侧区间，关联层的重合边界一起合并，非空文字以空格连接。
9b2a6f25d056043c701ab3364f715db73842ce8f.translation: Backspace/Delete removes selected annotations, leaving blank time. Linked lower selections follow; independent tiers remain. On an internal boundary, it merges adjacent intervals and coincident linked boundaries, joining nonempty labels with a space.

65287ac3b36ff76fae8d3c76671e5f893efdb574.source: <s id="0">Ctrl＋C / X / V</s>：复制 / 剪切完整标注，再点击同角色的足够长空白位置粘贴，保留文字、原时长、内部音素边界与多选间距。不会递增声调或取下一词表条目。
65287ac3b36ff76fae8d3c76671e5f893efdb574.translation: <s id="0">Ctrl+C / X / V</s> copies/cuts full annotations; click a sufficiently long same-role blank to paste. Retains text, durations, internal phoneme boundaries, and group spacing, without tone increments or consuming wordlist items.

70841360ebb76c41e4e8bd3d04850c579d9ecc07.source: <s id="0">Ctrl / Meta＋Z</s>：最多撤销 50 步。剪贴、拖动、整批替换可撤销；有待定起点时先取消起点。换录音后清空该文件撤销历史。
70841360ebb76c41e4e8bd3d04850c579d9ecc07.translation: <s id="0">Ctrl/Meta+Z</s> undoes up to 50 steps, including clipboard, dragging, and batch replace. Pending start cancels first. Switching recordings clears that file's undo history.

b22c9228524e322a7f8b4edd0414a76cc1d6e4a9.source: 图面快捷键与输入框的区别

f2c324bab1346dba38625e7adac416295ac12994.translation: Move whole interval by nudge step

c5b3b34dfeca5be0ad4e9fe7cd9eba9d6141143d.translation: Search words and replace whole labels

d8ac306722e4902cae0b0c2f6ab737696c6aad0d.source: 点击最上方的搜索替换按钮打开弹窗。关闭或按Esc后不占图下空间，查询和替换文字保留。重新打开时会按当前标注重新计算匹配，适用于编辑或撤销后继续查找。
d8ac306722e4902cae0b0c2f6ab737696c6aad0d.translation: Open Search and replace from the top. Close/Esc removes the dialog from below plots while retaining query/replacement. Reopening recalculates matches from current annotation, useful after edits/undo.

55ea2039290d194ff5a102bcdeb2b740fff1a8d6.source: 在<s id="0">搜索词层文本</s>输入关键词，定位第一项并显示数量。点<s id="1">上一个 / 下一个</s>循环检查；搜索框 Enter 下一项，Shift＋Enter 上一项。
55ea2039290d194ff5a102bcdeb2b740fff1a8d6.translation: Enter <s id="0">Search word-tier text</s> to locate the first match/count. <s id="1">Previous / Next</s> cycles; Enter advances and Shift+Enter goes back in search input.

1ad907f7d65dacb9ae9dd435677df60560c2981f.source: 搜索替换弹窗显示当前位置与匹配数，支持上下项和Enter/Shift＋Enter定位，搜索内容在关闭后保留。
1ad907f7d65dacb9ae9dd435677df60560c2981f.translation: Search dialog with current index/count, previous/next and Enter/Shift+Enter navigation. Query persists after closing.

c189bce1e31338ddeabed14bca204e996bf5acae.source: 输入<s id="0">替换文本</s>，点击<s id="1">替换</s>更改当前区间。批量操作点<s id="2">全部替换</s>，核对弹窗数量和文字，再点<s id="3">替换全部</s>。
c189bce1e31338ddeabed14bca204e996bf5acae.translation: Enter <s id="0">Replacement text</s> and <s id="1">Replace</s> current interval. For batches, <s id="2">Replace all</s>, check count/text in confirmation, then <s id="3">Replace all</s>.

93fcbdad4ee6c958a837d313da830cff67b8e941.source: 替换更改整个区间标签，词与音素关联时重新填充音素，取消关联后只替换词层。操作后检查相关边界，不合适时回到图面 Ctrl＋Z 撤销，或取消弹窗后逐项修改。
93fcbdad4ee6c958a837d313da830cff67b8e941.translation: Replacement changes whole labels and refills linked phonemes; unlinking changes words only. Check boundaries afterward; Ctrl+Z in plots undoes, or cancel and edit individually.

b696a00f9fc457da259871729c64b469ad0e6cf8.source: 例如搜索 sh 会同时找到 shi4 与 shang4，替换时两者整段标签都受影响。空替换文字会清空词标签，仍需核对音素层。
b696a00f9fc457da259871729c64b469ad0e6cf8.translation: Searching sh finds shi4 and shang4; replacement affects both entire labels. Empty replacement clears words; check phonemes too.

62a6ec108e002f51b81c25781173bf0851a4fa36.source: 全部替换前核对匹配数量和替换文字；取消会返回原搜索弹窗，保留查询与替换内容。
62a6ec108e002f51b81c25781173bf0851a4fa36.translation: Before replacing all, check match count/text. Cancel returns to search with both fields retained.

ddede5df5c657fc83b852a2312a578fe16a85a47.source: 在右侧点<s id="0">选择参考 TextGrid</s>并核对文件名。参考须与当前录音使用相同秒时间域，对应层名、类型和范围须兼容，不会按语速自动伸缩。
ddede5df5c657fc83b852a2312a578fe16a85a47.translation: <s id="0">Choose reference TextGrid</s> on the right and verify name. It must share the recording's seconds domain with compatible tier names/types/ranges. No speech-rate stretching occurs.

8ec61086fd7a16397583e13b3b53402c222e5992.source: 四种范围与受影响的层

70393803a54c05fb7d2231fb58f265939fe57fee.source: 选<s id="0">复用模式</s>，填写范围；起点之前 / 之后不使用终点，终点框禁用。
70393803a54c05fb7d2231fb58f265939fe57fee.translation: Choose <s id="0">Reuse mode</s> and range. Before/after start does not use the end; its field disables.

421c8b731f29a4d5d828d860cb7ae9a214631f43.source: 点击<s id="0">复用参考标注</s>，检查所有同名层与拼接边界，再保存。结果不适合可 Ctrl＋Z 撤销。
421c8b731f29a4d5d828d860cb7ae9a214631f43.translation: <s id="0">Reuse reference annotation</s>, check all same-name tiers/splices, and save. Ctrl+Z undoes unsuitable results.

0a4ce1cfde04313a1551e0856fa690378d785c74.source: 复用包括兼容的点层和区间层。无同名层、类型或范围不符时按提示处理。<s id="0">清除参考</s>仅解除关联，已复制的内容需撤销或重新编辑。
0a4ce1cfde04313a1551e0856fa690378d785c74.translation: Reuse includes compatible point/interval tiers. Resolve missing-name/type/range errors as instructed. <s id="0">Clear reference</s> unlinks only; undo/edit copied content separately.

42756ad2499c0f59ea9fd335a8d37cb416a1645a.source: 选择同一时间域的参考示例，在0.5–1秒区间之内复用。此例未关联唇形曲线。
42756ad2499c0f59ea9fd335a8d37cb416a1645a.translation: Compatible-time reference example, reusing inside 0.5–1 second. No lip curves are linked.

6d2351899a8289a995365cb21f54dc71922477ed.source: 图窗、强度与唇形时间对齐

b866b2e24ae2e7a0392a995ee1045a19c647c613.source: 移动可见窗与改变语谱窗长
b866b2e24ae2e7a0392a995ee1045a19c647c613.translation: Move views and change spectrogram windows

8a51a99091c79967f4889fac3edb559e6cd98e79.source: <s id="0">Ctrl＋滚轮</s>缩放时间，<s id="1">Shift＋滚轮</s>左右平移。也可填写视窗、点击前一窗 / 后一窗，或拖动时间窗起点滑条。视窗可填 0.08 s 至录音时长，填总时长可看全段。
8a51a99091c79967f4889fac3edb559e6cd98e79.translation: <s id="0">Ctrl+wheel</s> zooms time; <s id="1">Shift+wheel</s> pans. Also use window length, Previous/Next window, or start slider. Range 0.08 s to full duration; enter full duration for all.

b21006226d52c85f5f164696399ad61debc9262d.source: 语谱<s id="0">窗长</s>默认 20 ms，可选 5、10、20、50、100 ms 或 1024 点（兼容）。长窗便于看频率结构，短窗便于看时间变化。显示当前所选声道，在强度贴合弹窗选择声道后同步切换，频率上限为 5000 Hz 与预览采样率一半的较小值。
b21006226d52c85f5f164696399ad61debc9262d.translation: Spectrogram <s id="0">Window length</s> defaults to 20 ms; choose 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 ms or 1024 points (compatibility). Long windows show frequency structure, short windows time changes. Uses selected channel, following intensity-dialog changes. Frequency limit is min(5000 Hz, half preview rate).

70ff36d9b3d72906dfe714e69d69ba0d24192c7d.source: 绿色曲线与强度贴合的区别

85c491b67cab61b0d28db960e06dba0500c8f7ea.source: 绿色曲线表示<s id="0">相对强度</s>，可辅助观察起止。强度贴合使用独立的候选计算，显示曲线高度不能直接当作边界依据或声压级。
85c491b67cab61b0d28db960e06dba0500c8f7ea.translation: The green curve is <s id="0">relative intensity</s>, helping inspect onsets/offsets. Fitting calculates candidates independently; displayed height is neither direct boundary evidence nor SPL.

1fa33d3c10b0dfe01aaac0d6a2e60df8d92159e5.source: 选范围后打开强度贴合弹窗
1fa33d3c10b0dfe01aaac0d6a2e60df8d92159e5.translation: Select a range, then open fitting

7d62f46d00665e6ec54fbd9a488b94ddb26956b9.source: 先拖选波形 / 语谱，再点击顶部强度贴合按钮。先从声道列表选择要计算的声道，不会自动选择第一声道。波形、语谱、相对强度和试听随之切换。弹窗自动带入选区，也可填写起终点，让目标音节落在<s id="0">长于 50 ms</s>的范围内，且音节已有文字。
7d62f46d00665e6ec54fbd9a488b94ddb26956b9.translation: Drag waveform/spectrogram, then top Intensity fitting. Choose a channel explicitly; channel one is not automatic. Waveform, spectrogram, relative intensity, and audition follow. Range defaults to selection or manual times. A labeled syllable must lie in a range <s id="0">longer than 50 ms</s>.

23bec62bdf411a1ac379d5f11e8b41dce717b7e1.source: 设置<s id="0">内收/外扩</s>，默认 10 ms，正值内收、负值外扩，范围 −50 至 80 ms。点击<s id="1">执行贴合</s>。
23bec62bdf411a1ac379d5f11e8b41dce717b7e1.translation: Set <s id="0">Inset/expand</s>, default 10 ms, positive inward/negative outward, −50 to 80 ms. <s id="1">Run fitting</s>.

6cb145e06f2c541513a4fca736b93e53a76b150a.source: 查看调整反馈，检查音节与音素外边界并逐段试听。不合适用 Ctrl＋Z 撤销，再手工修改。
6cb145e06f2c541513a4fca736b93e53a76b150a.translation: Check feedback and syllable/phoneme outer boundaries; audition each. Undo with Ctrl+Z and adjust manually if needed.

c5d025afddb6f1cdf4210c493acf447e10d84ad0.source: 没有变化时先检查范围、标签和强度变化。弱音、噪声或短片段可能没有可靠候选，保留人工边界即可。
c5d025afddb6f1cdf4210c493acf447e10d84ad0.translation: Without changes, check range, labels, and intensity variation. Weak/noisy/short segments may lack reliable candidates; retain manual boundaries.

3467a2daf4dae107bc62af5c368940a7fb03b481.source: 从顶部打开强度贴合，明确选择声道后设置范围和内收/外扩。本例选择第2声道，未选声道时不能执行。
3467a2daf4dae107bc62af5c368940a7fb03b481.translation: Top fitting dialog with explicit channel and range/inset settings. Channel 2 is selected; no execution without channel selection.

4670ee67c6405a90ee266c87038882478425948b.source: 关联同次录音的唇形记录
4670ee67c6405a90ee266c87038882478425948b.translation: Link lip data from the same recording

d40d2018ccf35b7aaa65fbd215ddc3c2eb3ad064.source: 在右侧<s id="0">唇形记录</s>选择同次录音的记录。同名记录可自动关联；没有配套记录时保持<s id="1">不关联</s>。本章自然语句图示没有配套真实唇形。
d40d2018ccf35b7aaa65fbd215ddc3c2eb3ad064.translation: Choose same-session <s id="0">Lip recording</s> on the right. Same names may link automatically. Without corresponding data, keep <s id="1">Unlinked</s>. This chapter's natural-sentence figure has no real paired lip recording.

3b4f07437feb470a7e2355fa40a6200fc3e6aa91.source: 载入后红色表示唇开，蓝色表示唇宽。两曲线分别缩放，只用于比较时间变化，曲线高度不能直接比较几何数值。
3b4f07437feb470a7e2355fa40a6200fc3e6aa91.translation: Red is lip opening and blue width. Curves scale separately for timing comparison; heights cannot compare geometry directly.

bc7e926cb171628ea0cb6f2a88be84c5e61865e8.source: 共同偏移的方向与细调
bc7e926cb171628ea0cb6f2a88be84c5e61865e8.translation: Shared offset direction and fine adjustment

f9c211700e44f5f17283f1bdc1a3759e9f3d6ccf.source: 确认记录与录音对应，并检查<s id="0">唇开 / 唇宽</s>显隐开关。没有宽度数据时，唇宽不可用。
f9c211700e44f5f17283f1bdc1a3759e9f3d6ccf.translation: Verify recording correspondence and <s id="0">Opening / Width</s> visibility. Width is unavailable without data.

859fbdc6ec9941276aa35fc0bfb76403c705756a.source: 填写<s id="0">共同时间偏移（ms）</s>：<s id="1">正值移向更晚，负值移向更早</s>，允许 ±3600000 ms。两曲线一起移动，TextGrid 边界保持。
859fbdc6ec9941276aa35fc0bfb76403c705756a.translation: Set <s id="0">Shared time offset (ms)</s>: <s id="1">positive later, negative earlier</s>, within ±3600000 ms. Both curves move; TextGrid stays.

27f8c734c7a7023dbd262e6782ec2c10b4048397.source: 点<s id="0">← 1 ms / 1 ms →</s>或图面 <s id="1">Alt＋左右方向键</s>微调，按住可连续移动；加 Shift 为 10 ms。结合多个发音起止和试听核对。
27f8c734c7a7023dbd262e6782ec2c10b4048397.translation: Use <s id="0">← 1 ms / 1 ms →</s> or plot <s id="1">Alt+left/right</s>; hold to repeat, Shift for 10 ms. Check multiple speech onsets/offsets and audition.

c7038061f69ea28b126eaf7432c7f4432d7a8f9b.source: 唇形时间与标注时间分别保存
c7038061f69ea28b126eaf7432c7f4432d7a8f9b.translation: Save lip and annotation timing separately

a686463cce8535405e4ca1986b55e7d5127ed984.source: 调整完点击<s id="0">保存唇偏</s>，等独立成功反馈，检查星号消失。失败时偏移仍保留，处理提示后重试。
a686463cce8535405e4ca1986b55e7d5127ed984.translation: <s id="0">Save lip offset</s>, wait for its own success, and check asterisk disappearance. Failed saving retains offset; resolve and retry.

7ed115ba40fe1efc0288dcc7558b4e032bd5f0a7.source: <s id="0">保存 TextGrid 与保存唇偏要分别检查</s>。唇偏写入 metadata.lip_manual_offset，原时间数组保留；不要在数组和元数据中重复加入同一偏移。
7ed115ba40fe1efc0288dcc7558b4e032bd5f0a7.translation: <s id="0">Check TextGrid and lip-offset saving separately</s>. Offset writes metadata.lip_manual_offset and keeps original arrays. Do not add the same offset twice to arrays/metadata.

fee07f717ec9f308a6c5e9ee3ee97e7cfac69920.source: 图窗、文字与强度参数。当前强度参数从顶部强度贴合按钮打开弹窗。
fee07f717ec9f308a6c5e9ee3ee97e7cfac69920.translation: Viewport/text/intensity parameters. Intensity currently opens from the top fitting button.

4756d2bebbe592d9546657ec6449ed244737c779.translation: 3.2 s, or all for shorter files

463936a9cbdc55dee93b65217a89d539e8fb5052.source: 改变可见范围，0.08 s 至总时长
463936a9cbdc55dee93b65217a89d539e8fb5052.translation: Visible range, 0.08 s to full duration

e344945201f42760ac929e43c0e14bb8ef89c620.source: 长于 50 ms 且含有文字音节

1a2724e33e367347b19b11baacf48d87801d3170.source: 在右侧层级与保存中选择音节 / 词层、音素层及可选第三层，或点击新建第三层输入名称。新建整组标注时，第三层名可留空。第三层双击插入边界，单击区间后编辑文字，拖动区间可移动标注。隐藏第三层只改变显示，TextGrid 中的原有层仍保留。
1a2724e33e367347b19b11baacf48d87801d3170.translation: In right Tier and saving settings, choose syllable/word, phoneme, and optional third tiers, or create a named third tier. When creating a set, third name is optional. Double-click third tier for boundaries, click intervals to edit, and drag to move. Hiding affects display only, retaining original TextGrid tiers.

648577455d10f482096dd5304c5adedc3409c2e0.source: 顶部点击吸附与关联，在弹窗中切换层间边界吸附和各层关联。关闭弹窗后参数仍生效，控件不占用图下空间。层间边界吸附默认关闭。勾选后，拖动或插入的边界靠近其他可见层六个显示像素内时自动对齐。取消勾选即可按实际位置定界。吸附只对齐当前操作的边界。
648577455d10f482096dd5304c5adedc3409c2e0.translation: Open Snapping and links at the top to set boundary snapping and tier pairs. Closing retains settings without space below plots. Snapping defaults off. When on, dragged/inserted boundaries align within six displayed pixels of other visible tiers. Turn off to use actual positions. Only the operated boundary snaps.

6ca7045939c93b764d28300a368ac0dd328877bc.source: 第一层 ↔ 第二层默认勾选，第三层的两个关联默认关闭。按需要选择三个层对，关联层的重合边界双向一起移动和删除，内部边界不同的位置各自保留。第一层经第二层关联第三层时，三层形成同一关联组。所有关联层共同限制可移动范围，防止越过邻接边界。
6ca7045939c93b764d28300a368ac0dd328877bc.translation: Tier one ↔ two defaults on; both third-tier links default off. Choose among three pairs. Coincident linked boundaries move/delete bidirectionally; different internal positions remain separate. Linking one through two to three joins all three. All linked tiers constrain movement against adjacent boundaries.

cafdbd2acc16f85426864296f02da83ccf08c51e.source: 取消相关关联后，各层独立编辑。第一层改字、定起终点、词表顺序生成、整体移动、强度贴合或删除不会改变独立层。第一层整体移动、删除和剪贴会携带关联层选区内的标注，内部时间差保持；音素及第三层的区间内容操作各自独立。取消吸附和取消关联是两个独立选择。
cafdbd2acc16f85426864296f02da83ccf08c51e.translation: After unlinking, tiers edit independently. First-tier text, endpoints, sequential generation, moving, fitting, and deletion leave independent tiers unchanged. First-tier moves/deletes/clipboard carry linked selected annotations, retaining internal differences. Phoneme/third-tier content operations remain independent. Snapping and linking are separate choices.

e7f748cd0e813f7cfec599cd715cf6245d0167b6.source: 吸附与关联弹窗分别控制边界吸附和三个层对的关联，关闭后设置继续生效。
e7f748cd0e813f7cfec599cd715cf6245d0167b6.translation: Snapping/links dialog controls snapping and three tier pairs separately; settings remain after closing.

3ca54e54e4851bd9ceb705be58e9fdee4e8a7c50.source: 用浮动国际音标键盘输入

5ae2cdff48b10d3391dab3202307cf379d70c07e.source: 先单击需要填写的区间，在选中区间文本中放好光标，点击最上方的音标键盘按钮。默认显示紧凑 IPA 表，可切换 extIPA 或 VoQS。点符号插在光标处，有文字选区时替换选区。附加符号、连线和成对记号沿用国际音标表Plus的插入方式，原有码位保持。
5ae2cdff48b10d3391dab3202307cf379d70c07e.translation: Select an interval, place its text cursor, and open IPA keyboard at the top. Compact IPA is default; switch to extIPA/VoQS. Symbols insert at cursor or replace selected text. Diacritics, ties, and paired marks follow IPA Chart Plus input, retaining code points.

5eacb31a3c38d8618e8b8ca9595d3b8af71fc6e7.source: 拖动键盘标题栏可移动面板，拖动右下角可调整宽高；− / ＋按10%调整音标字号，范围60–180%。小窗口可以滚动表格。标题拖动按钮与右下角按钮获得键盘焦点后，也可用方向键移动或调整大小。按Esc或点击×关闭，切换到其他工具时键盘隐藏。在文本框内按Ctrl＋Z可撤销最近的音标键盘插入，Mac可用Command＋Z。
5eacb31a3c38d8618e8b8ca9595d3b8af71fc6e7.translation: Drag title to move, bottom right to resize. −/+ changes symbol size by 10%, range 60–180%. Scroll in small windows. Focused title/resize controls also use arrows. Esc/× closes; other tools hide it. Ctrl+Z in text undoes latest insertion; Mac uses Command+Z.

db5ba5689c498ed33dd2a6fb47350c021346b618.source: 尚未选择区间、正在保存或输入法仍在组字时，符号按键暂停输入。完成组字或选择区间后继续；TextGrid仍通过保存TextGrid保存。
db5ba5689c498ed33dd2a6fb47350c021346b618.translation: Symbols pause without a selected interval, during saving, or IME composition. Finish composition/select an interval to continue. Save TextGrid still writes annotation.

b711653a60ba9543e5c5147477ccbae62eb39bc7.source: 从顶部音标键盘按钮打开紧凑IPA表。选中标注后可插入符号，标题拖动位置，右下角调整大小。
b711653a60ba9543e5c5147477ccbae62eb39bc7.translation: Compact IPA from the top keyboard button. Select annotations to insert, drag title to move, bottom right to resize.

c181def784b06fe32c2a7d540ee61ced57abdffa.source: 输出为 Praat 长文本 TextGrid，中文、IPA、引号及全部保留层一同保存，时间按秒保存到六位小数。右侧<s id="0">当前 TextGrid</s>是读入版，<s id="1">目标</s>是写出版，请分开核对。
c181def784b06fe32c2a7d540ee61ced57abdffa.translation: Output is Praat long-text TextGrid, retaining Chinese, IPA, quotes, and all preserved tiers, with seconds to six decimals. Right <s id="0">Current TextGrid</s> is loaded, <s id="1">Target</s> is written; check separately.

06db96733e88d1492b71e983d05d841b757c9bb4.source: 保存自定后缀或确认覆盖
06db96733e88d1492b71e983d05d841b757c9bb4.translation: Save a suffix or confirm overwrite

54d5836ba4555e3bcad9f164019c053d88966b22.source: 检查右侧<s id="0">保存后缀</s>与目标，默认 sample.wav 保存为 sample_自动保存.TextGrid。后缀只填文件名的一部分，不填写目录。
54d5836ba4555e3bcad9f164019c053d88966b22.translation: Check <s id="0">Save suffix</s> and target. sample.wav defaults to sample_自动保存.TextGrid. Enter only filename suffix, not directories.

00d31d85dbab5101a5d2b5ce92a2b797324f045d.source: 点击<s id="0">保存 TextGrid</s>或 Ctrl / Meta＋S，等待本次成功反馈。
00d31d85dbab5101a5d2b5ce92a2b797324f045d.translation: <s id="0">Save TextGrid</s> or Ctrl/Meta+S, then wait for this save's success.

b2a398273b6e5bd6d2a023df7502b55d65926b9b.source: <s id="0">后缀留空时，桌面将覆盖 WAV 同名原始 TextGrid</s>，需确认后继续。网页会保存同名新版本，原资源保留。
b2a398273b6e5bd6d2a023df7502b55d65926b9b.translation: <s id="0">An empty suffix overwrites the WAV's original same-name TextGrid on desktop</s> after confirmation. Web saves a same-name new version and keeps the original resource.

2293d6a326d8e53e1944569bf854068d9cab8912.source: 以_手册示例后缀保存成功，当前TextGrid和目标名一致，中文与IPA文字已写入示例文件。
